description: This Kotlin test source file contains unit tests for the BookmarksViewModel class within the Android application. It verifies the ViewModel's behavior regarding loading states, bookmarking functionality, resource viewing, and undo operations in the context of bookmarked news resources, utilizing various testing utilities and mocking repositories.

classes.name: BookmarksViewModelTest
classes.description: Test suite for the BookmarksViewModel class, verifying its initial state, bookmark management, resource viewing, and undo functionality.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the BookmarksViewModel instance before each test.

methods.name: stateIsInitiallyLoading
methods.description: Verifies that the feed UI state is Loading upon initialization.

methods.name: oneBookmark_showsInFeed
methods.description: Tests that a bookmarked news resource appears in the feed.

methods.name: oneBookmark_whenRemoving_removesFromFeed
methods.description: Checks that removing a bookmarked resource updates the feed and triggers undo option.

methods.name: feedUiState_resourceIsViewed_setResourcesViewed
methods.description: Verifies that setting a news resource as viewed updates its state accordingly.

methods.name: feedUiState_undoneBookmarkRemoval_bookmarkIsRestored
methods.description: Tests that undoing a bookmark removal restores the resource in the feed.
